doctorate.title: Thus the Twain did meet? The two worlds of Giulio Aleni

evidence.says: York University identifies Bernard Luk as its history professor, states that he received his history PhD from Indiana University in 1977, and dates his arrival in York’s History Department to 1991.
In his witness statement, Bernard Luk Hung Kay identifies his York University position (paragraph 1) and states that he obtained a PhD in History at Indiana University in 1977 (paragraph 2).
WorldCat catalogues Thus the Twain did meet? The two worlds of Giulio Aleni as a 1977 thesis/dissertation by Bernard Hung-Kay Luk.

notes: The linked record matches the documented institution, year, author and dissertation title. WorldCat includes a question mark after “meet”; this punctuation difference does not indicate a different dissertation.
